papers.summary: A multi-omic gene-expression and chromatin-accessibility map of human coronary artery disease provides a framework for mapping disease-associated genetic variants to cell types, chromatin states and gene programmes in human disease

publisher_detail.text: Although coronary artery disease (CAD) genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified hundreds of loci, most variants lie in non-coding regions, obscuring the causal gene programmes and cell types driving disease 1,2 . Here we performed single-nucleus multi-omic profiling of gene expression and chromatin accessibility in human coronary arteries from 44 people to construct a genome-wide single-cell variant-to-enhancer-to-gene map. We identified 11,269 chromatin accessibility quantitative trait loci (caQTLs) across principal vascular cell types, including CAD-associated caQTLs in smooth muscle cells (SMCs). Using dynamic single-cell caQTL modelling 3 , we show that variant effects on chromatin vary across SMC states. For example, rs658956 -mediated suppression of the FGGY-DT enhancer through disruption of an AP-1 motif is amplified as SMCs transition towards a fibromyocyte fate. We next performed genome-wide high-throughput chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C) in 15 human coronary arteries, showing that rs4887091 in the ADAMTS7 CAD locus has allele-dependent effects on CCCTC-binding factor occupancy and loop strength. Integrating Hi-C, Hi-C with chromatin immunoprecipitation and in vitro clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats interference (CRISPRi) nominated AMOTL2 as a distal SMC-specific CAD gene whose loss promotes proliferation and suppresses contractile identity. Finally, arrayed Perturb-seq of GWAS-nominated enhancers converged on extracellular matrix remodelling as a core SMC disease programme. Together, these findings provide a framework for mapping non-coding GWAS variants to cell types, chromatin states and gene programmes in human disease.
publisher_detail.text_zh: 尽管针对冠状动脉疾病的全基因组关联研究已经发现了数百个相关位点，但大多数变异都位于非编码区域，这使得我们难以明确哪些基因程序及细胞类型才是导致该疾病的真正原因1,2。在此研究中，我们对44名受试者的人类冠状动脉进行了单核多组学分析，包括基因表达与染色质可及性的检测，从而构建了涵盖全基因组的单细胞变异-增强子-基因关联图谱。我们共在多种血管细胞类型中发现了11,269个与染色质可及性相关的数量性状位点，其中也包括那些与冠状动脉疾病相关的位点——这些位点主要存在于平滑肌细胞中3。通过动态单细胞分析技术，我们发现这些变异对染色质状态的影响会因不同类型的平滑肌细胞而有所差异。例如，rs658956这个位点所导致的FFGY-DT增强子活性抑制作用，在平滑肌细胞向纤维肌细胞转化的过程中会变得更为显著。随后，我们对15个人类冠状动脉样本进行了全基因组高通量染色体构象捕获分析，结果发现ADAMTS7基因座中的rs4887091这个位点其等位基因的不同类型会对CCCTC结合因子在染色质上的结合位置及染色质环结构的稳定性产生不同的影响。综合这些研究结果，我们最终确定AMOTL2是一个特异性存在于平滑肌细胞中的基因；该基因的缺失会促进平滑肌细胞的增殖，并抑制其收缩功能的形成。此外，通过对全基因组关联研究中鉴定出的增强子进行进一步分析，我们发现细胞外基质的重塑是导致平滑肌细胞病变的核心机制之一。综上所述，这些研究结果为将非编码区域的基因变异与人类疾病中的特定细胞类型、染色质状态及基因程序联系起来提供了重要的理论基础。

all_papers.title: Single-cell variant-to-enhancer-to-gene map for coronary artery disease
all_papers.summary: A multi-omic gene-expression and chromatin-accessibility map of human coronary artery disease provides a framework for mapping disease-associated genetic variants to cell types, chromatin states and gene programmes in human disease
all_papers.llm_title_zh: 冠状动脉疾病的单细胞变异-增强子-基因关联图谱
all_papers.llm_title_bilingual: 冠状动脉疾病的单细胞变异-增强子-基因关联图谱 / Single-cell variant-to-enhancer-to-gene map for coronary artery disease
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 一份关于人类冠状动脉疾病的多组学基因表达与染色质可及性图谱，为将与疾病相关的遗传变异与人体疾病中的特定细胞类型、染色质状态及基因表达程序联系起来提供了理论基础。

publisher_detail.text: Although coronary artery disease (CAD) genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified hundreds of loci, most variants lie in non-coding regions, obscuring the causal gene programmes and cell types driving disease 1,2 . Here we performed single-nucleus multi-omic profiling of gene expression and chromatin accessibility in human coronary arteries from 44 people to construct a genome-wide single-cell variant-to-enhancer-to-gene map. We identified 11,269 chromatin accessibility quantitative trait loci (caQTLs) across principal vascular cell types, including CAD-associated caQTLs in smooth muscle cells (SMCs). Using dynamic single-cell caQTL modelling 3 , we show that variant effects on chromatin vary across SMC states. For example, rs658956 -mediated suppression of the FGGY-DT enhancer through disruption of an AP-1 motif is amplified as SMCs transition towards a fibromyocyte fate. We next performed genome-wide high-throughput chromosome conformation capture (Hi-C) in 15 human coronary arteries, showing that rs4887091 in the ADAMTS7 CAD locus has allele-dependent effects on CCCTC-binding factor occupancy and loop strength. Integrating Hi-C, Hi-C with chromatin immunoprecipitation and in vitro clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats interference (CRISPRi) nominated AMOTL2 as a distal SMC-specific CAD gene whose loss promotes proliferation and suppresses contractile identity. Finally, arrayed Perturb-seq of GWAS-nominated enhancers converged on extracellular matrix remodelling as a core SMC disease programme. Together, these findings provide a framework for mapping non-coding GWAS variants to cell types, chromatin states and gene programmes in human disease.

all_papers.primary_summary_raw: Although coronary artery disease (CAD) genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified hundreds of loci, most variants lie in non-coding regions, obscuring the causal gene programmes and cell types driving disease 1,2 . all_papers.title: A gut–brain sensory-motor circuit regulates sugar ingestion in Drosophila
all_papers.summary: In flies, sugar-sensing enteric neurons activate brain neurons that inhibit crop duct motor neurons, relaxing the foregut muscles to facilitate food transfer to the crop, which sustains ingestion and regulates food intake
all_papers.llm_title_zh: 在果蝇中，肠道与大脑之间的感觉运动回路负责调节糖分的摄入量。
all_papers.llm_title_bilingual: 在果蝇中，肠道与大脑之间的感觉运动回路负责调节糖分的摄入量。 / A gut–brain sensory-motor circuit regulates sugar ingestion in Drosophila
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 在果蝇中，能够感知糖分的肠道神经元会激活大脑中的相关神经元，这些神经元会抑制负责控制嗉囊肌肉运动的神经元，从而使前肠肌肉放松，从而促进食物进入嗉囊。这一机制有助于维持进食过程并调节食物的摄入量。

all_papers.title: An extremophile transgene improves drought resistance and yield in cereals
all_papers.summary: The use of an extremophile fungus-derived gene decouples the trade-off of drought stress and reduced crop yield by boosting drought resilience and increasing yields in wheat, rice and maize
all_papers.llm_title_zh: 一种极端环境适应性转基因基因能够显著提升谷物的抗旱能力并增加其产量。
all_papers.llm_title_bilingual: 一种极端环境适应性转基因基因能够显著提升谷物的抗旱能力并增加其产量。 / An extremophile transgene improves drought resistance and yield in cereals
all_papers.llm_rss_summary_zh: 利用这种源自极端环境真菌的基因，可以消除干旱胁迫与作物产量下降之间的矛盾——该基因能够增强小麦、水稻和玉米的抗旱能力，从而提高其产量。
